# Acme

> The domain-agnostic core of a multi-tenant system, in the shape of the Software Design and Architecture Guidelines: one object model at the center, one infrastructure toolkit, an API process and a maintenance worker around them, and a portal, a command line, and a TypeScript and a Python client at the edge. A product renames it and builds its domain on top.

This file is the knowledge map. Each section lists the documents one
audience is served; a document not listed under an audience is not
served to it. Exposure is by listing, never by folder.

## Platform developers

- [README](README.md): what Acme is, the quick start with the local URLs and sign-ins, set up and check, deploy and operate, and the layout
- [Architecture](specs/architecture.md): the guideline's pin, the substitutions, and the deviations, each linking its decision record under docs/adr/
- [What Acme is made of](om/README.md): the nouns and how they relate, for a reader with no code
- [Tenancy](om/src/acme/om/tenancy/README.md): orgs, identities, users, memberships, invitations, sessions, API keys, socket tickets, the operator plane, and deletion
- [Events](om/src/acme/om/events/README.md): the org's stream, its gapless sequence above a floor, and audit entries
- [Outbox rows](om/src/acme/om/outbox/README.md): the note written beside every change, and its relay
- [Idempotency records](om/src/acme/om/idempotency/README.md): the outcome of a request that may arrive twice
- [Work items](om/src/acme/om/work/README.md): background jobs, the claim, the lease, and the dead letter
- [Orchestrations](om/src/acme/om/orchestrations/README.md): long-running records, a step at a time, that park or fail
- [Leases](om/src/acme/om/leases/README.md): a resource one holder uses at a time, its lease under a fencing token, and the line in front of it
- [Files](om/src/acme/om/media/README.md): files as references, the bounded upload straight to the store, and the sweep
- [Agent sessions](om/src/acme/om/agent_sessions/README.md): sessions as a series of loops over one history, and the status read off their steps
- [Steps](om/src/acme/om/steps/README.md): the history, written once and numbered with no gaps, and the epoch that refuses a stale run
- [Agents](om/src/acme/om/agents/README.md): agent kinds, sub-agents in a tree that shares one budget and one deadline, hand-offs, the result gate, and the loop every agent runs: each step persisted before it is acted on, recovery by effect under a new epoch, provider errors by kind and the outage signal, streams, steering, and taking over
- [Attribution](om/src/acme/om/attribution/README.md): who acted, on whose authority, and who pays; the untrusted mark and the rule of two
- [Privacy](om/src/acme/om/privacy/README.md): content sealed per session under a versioned key, the storage policies, and the revocation that erases content and keeps shape
- [Budgets](om/src/acme/om/budgets/README.md): what may be spent, the one gate every model call passes first, holds at the worst case, and their settlement
- [Models](om/src/acme/om/models/README.md): model roles, fills, fill sets and their switches, the resolver, and prices
- [Windows](om/src/acme/om/windows/README.md): what a model reads: the request rendered from the history, the window sized for its model, the pinned zone, compaction into summaries, and artifacts
- [Tools](om/src/acme/om/tools/README.md): the tool contract, the registry, policy by class and target, approvals bound to one call, failures, recovery by effect, jobs
- [Infrastructure](infra/README.md): cache, buckets, topics, queues, secrets, keys, flags, the outage signal, observability, workspaces and the transport; what each promises and which twin runs where
- [Integrations](integrations/README.md): the identity provider, its twin, the absent provider, and the webhook check; the model providers, their adapters, and the scripted twin
- [The API process](services/api/README.md): the routes by area, the gateway's guarantees, the subcommands
- [The maintenance worker](workers/maintenance/README.md): the work queue's loop, the provider deliveries, and the sweep
- [The session runner](workers/session_runner/README.md): the worker that claims a session's loop and runs it under a lease, and takes a lost runner's loop over under a new epoch
- [Deployment](deployment/README.md): what runs where, locally and in the cloud, and the branch convention
- [The local stack](deployment/local/README.md): every URL and port, one service at a time
- [Terraform](deployment/terraform/modules/README.md): the roots, the modules, the state, and the credentials
- [Cloud cost](deployment/cloud/README.md): the sizes, each environment's size, and the budgets
- [Operations](ops/README.md): roles, profiles, credentials, signals, the ops binary, the skills, the audits
- [Audit tools](ops/audit/README.md): what the audit skills run
- [Stress tests](ops/stress/README.md): what a good one is and the scenario file
- [Runbooks](docs/runbooks/README.md): one file per operational procedure
- [The portal](apps/portal/README.md): the browser app shell
- [The company site](apps/site/README.md): the static page and where it is served
- [The command line](apps/cli/README.md): the terminal client and its exit codes
- [The TypeScript client](clients/typescript/README.md): the one client every browser app imports
- [The Python client](clients/python/README.md): the one client every Python caller goes through
- [The engine's checker](checkers/README.md): agentic-check, the engine's lenses a parser decides, its configuration, and its exceptions
